name: Swarm Of Rats
description: A skittering mass of ordinary rodents moving as one like a ravenous wave.

abilities.name: Horde (1d4+1)
abilities.description: When the Swarm has marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 1d4+1 physical damage instead.

abilities.name: In Your Face
abilities.description: All targets within Melee range have disadvantage on attacks against targets other than the Swarm.
